In re : CRAN 1 of 2025 1. Service Report filed by the State, be kept with the records.
In spite of service, nobody appears for the victim / defacto complainant.

2. The petitioner was convicted under Section 376(2)(I) of the Indian Penal Code and Sections 6/8 of the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act and was sentenced to suffer imprisonment for life.

sentences.text: He prays for suspension of sentence pending disposal of the appeal.
He says that he is in custody for about one year six months post conviction.
He was on bail during trial.
3. Learned Advocates for the parties draw our attention to the depositions on record and in particular to the evidence of P.W.1 (victim girl) and P.W.8 (examining doctor).
Firstly, what we find is that the first information report was lodged after a delay of eight months.
Prima facie, there does not seem to be any satisfactory or acceptable explanation for such delay.
Secondly, what emerges from the deposition of the victim girl is that she had infatuation for the petitioner.
She used to send messages and her photographs on WhatsApp to the petitioner.
Thirdly, there is no vivid or sufficient narration of the alleged incident of rape.
The medical report is inconclusive.

4. We also find that the petitioner was on bail during trial and it is nobody's case that he misused the liberty of bail during trial in any manner.
5.

In view of the aforesaid, we are of the view that the petitioner may have a prima facie arguable Partha Pratim Sarkar vs Unknown on 5 March, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/84555513/

sentences.text: Hence, we allow this application and suspend the sentence of imprisonment imposed upon the applicant/appellant.

6. Accordingly, we direct that the applicant/appellant, namely Partha Pratim Sarkar shall be released on bail upon furnishing a bond of Rs.10,000/-, with two sureties of like amount each, one of whom must be local, to the satisfaction of the learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Nadia at Krishnagar, and on further conditions that he shall not enter the jurisdiction of Nabadwip Police Station until further order and shall inform his local current address where he shall be presently residing to the learned Trial Court and shall meet the Inspector in charge/Officer in charge of the jurisdictional police station once in a fortnight till disposal of the appeal and shall remain within the geographical limits of District Nadia until further order.

The applicant shall be personally present or shall be represented by his Counsel during hearing of the appeal and he shall surrender before the Trial Court as and when called for in connection with the present appeal.

7. The department is directed to forward a copy of this order to the Superintendent of the concerned Correctional Home for immediate release of the applicant/appellant unless he is wanted in connection with any other case.

8. We clarify that the observations made by us in this order are only for the purpose of disposing of the application for suspension of sentence and the same shall have no relevance at the final hearing of the appeal.
9. The application being CRAN 1 of 2025 is accordingly disposed of.
10. All parties shall act in terms of server copy of the order downloaded from the official website of this Court.
(Apurba Sinha Ray, J.) (Arijit Banerjee, J.)
